description: Split names into random fair teams by team count or team size, using a Fisher-Yates shuffle with round-robin distribution.

faqs.a: Yes. Every name is shuffled with the Fisher-Yates algorithm and dealt round-robin, so teams differ by at most one player.
Pick the mode you want: a fixed number of teams, or a fixed team size (the tool computes how many teams that makes).
faqs.q: Can I choose team size instead of team count?

faqs.a: Press Shuffle again — every press re-randomizes with a fresh shuffle.
Yes, everything runs locally in your browser.

howto: Choose team count or team size and set the number.
Press Shuffle teams — copy or download the result.
title: Random Team Generator
